pathSource:
<?php
function ttl($flag, $unused) { return $flag ? 30 : 60; }
function bridge($flag) { return ttl($flag, expensive()); }
function page() { return bridge(true); }
function other() { return bridge(false); }
function unrelated() { return 0; }
function constantTtl() { return 7; }
function hidden() { if (false) { constantTtl(); } }
function dynamic($callee) { return $callee(true, expensive()); }
function pair($left, $right) { return $left . $right; }
function pairs() { pair('a', 'b'); pair('c', 'd'); }
function foreign() { pair(expensive(), expensive()); }
final class CacheQuery {
    public function execute($ttl, $tag) { return [$ttl, $tag]; }
}
final class Endpoint {
    public function show() { return (new CacheQuery())->execute(30, 'product'); }
    public function preview() { return (new CacheQuery())->execute(60, 'draft'); }
}
